_about: unified-agent-memory hooks for Claude Code — paste the "hooks" object into ~/.claude/settings.json. Replace ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} with this repository's absolute install path first (see integrations/claude/hooks/HOOKS.md for the full wiring guide). Delete this _about key after pasting; it is documentation, not configuration. Interpreter is python3 on macOS/Linux and python on Windows; the setup installer picks the right one automatically, so only change python3 to python if you paste this by hand on Windows.
